title: Fog on the Lakes
offer: A fog has fallen, and my children Ivar and Märta rowed out to the islands this morning! Old Halvard knows the islands best. Please find them!

steps.say: In this fog? Listen... I heard children's voices by Bergö, the island of the potter. Row there, slowly!

steps.load_say: They were sitting by my kiln to keep warm. Here, take them home, they are not hurt, only cold.

steps.say: Ivar! Märta! You are home! Thank you, thank you. You are the bravest girls on the lakes.

fact: In the fog, sailors listened for bells, voices and the surf on the shore.
